description: Execute the same no_std SVG renderer and shared VFS loader inside Dunit. Check gradient/alpha pixels, every shipped vector at three sizes, existing RGBA fallback, SVG wallpaper and rejected active content. Kernel boot deliberately faults isolation/thread-test children; require svg_test exit code zero and its own failure/panic markers absent rather than forbidding those expected boot faults.
required: [SVG-TEST] native gradients and straight alpha OK
[SVG-TEST] bitmap compatibility, wallpaper and invalid SVG rejection OK
[ICON-THEME] breeze-chameleon-dark aliases, sizes, direct path OK
[ICON-THEME] breeze-chameleon-light aliases, sizes, direct path OK
[ICON-THEME] breeze-round-chameleon-dark aliases, sizes, direct path OK
[ICON-THEME] breeze-round-chameleon-light aliases, sizes, direct path OK
[ICON-THEME] chameleon-symbolic-dark aliases, sizes, direct path OK
[ICON-THEME] five sequential presets and config roundtrips OK
